name: phapi/phapi
description: A lightweight, high-performance wrapper for Swoole HTTP server with routing, middleware, validation, CORS, and async task support

suggest.ext-redis: Required for Redis support under Swoole 6.x.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required for MySQL support under Swoole 6.x.
suggest.hyperf/config: Required for ORM support. Install: composer require hyperf/config hyperf/database hyperf/db-connection
suggest.open-telemetry/api: Required for tracing. Install: composer require open-telemetry/api open-telemetry/sdk open-telemetry/context-swoole open-telemetry/exporter-otlp open-telemetry/sem-conv
